text.en: A new road, then. I'll bring my sword; you bring a little curiosity.
text.zh-CN: 那就换条路走走。我带剑，你带上点好奇心。

text.en: This is the healer's garden. I hope we've caught someone at home.
text.zh-CN: 这里就是药师的花园了。但愿有人在。

text.en: I'm Gerda. What happened?
text.zh-CN: 我是格尔达。出什么事了？

text.en: A friend has been poisoned. His eyes are badly hurt.
text.zh-CN: 一位朋友中了毒，眼睛伤得很重。

text.en: I'll need the Nightshade Blossom before I can help. Try the wandering medicine seller for a lead.
text.zh-CN: 想帮上忙，得先找到夜影花这种药材。去问问那位游方药商，也许有线索。

text.en: Will you come with us?
text.zh-CN: 你愿意和我们一起去吗？

text.en: Yes. Let me gather my things. Kai, please don't investigate anything poisonous with your fingers.
text.zh-CN: 好，等我收拾一下。凯，碰到像是有毒的东西，请别先伸手确认。

text.en: A moment, Horus. We can settle the misunderstanding while we walk.
text.zh-CN: 等一下，荷鲁斯。误会可以边走边说。

text.en: Then walk quickly. I mean to catch up with her.
text.zh-CN: 那就走快些。我得追上她。

text.en: Together, then. Two pairs of eyes are better than one.
text.zh-CN: 一起吧。两个人找，总比一个人容易。

text.en: Agreed. Take these supplies; we'll sort out the parcel later.
text.zh-CN: 好。这些补给你先拿着，包裹的事稍后再说。

text.en: Horus? What's going on?
text.zh-CN: 荷鲁斯？这是怎么回事？

text.en: Isis leaves a gift when she chooses. Arguing won't improve it.
text.zh-CN: 伊西斯决定送出的礼物，可不是拿来争论的。

text.en: And there she goes. We should follow.
text.zh-CN: 说完就走了。我们得跟上。

text.en: That would be easier than arguing with a departing boat.
text.zh-CN: 确实，比对着一条开走的船讲道理容易些。

text.en: Come on, then. I'll travel with you.
text.zh-CN: 走吧，我和你同行。

text.en: The gold is safe. Thank you for coming.
text.zh-CN: 黄金保住了。谢谢你们赶来。

text.en: Where next, Horus?
text.zh-CN: 接下来去哪儿，荷鲁斯？

text.en: Highbridge. There is someone I need to see.
text.zh-CN: 高桥城。我要去见一个人。

text.en: Then let's share the road.
text.zh-CN: 那就一起走吧。

text.en: Gladly. And I owe you an apology for our last meeting.
text.zh-CN: 好。上次见面时的事，我也该向你道个歉。

text.en: A misunderstanding. A rather energetic one.
text.zh-CN: 一场误会。就是闹得稍微热闹了点。

text.en: That is one word for it.
text.zh-CN: 你倒挺会挑词。

text.en: I'm Alice. You wouldn't happen to know where King Arthur went?
text.zh-CN: 我是爱丽丝。你们知不知道，亚瑟王去哪儿了？

text.en: We've met. I could help you look.
text.zh-CN: 见过。我可以和你一起找找。

text.en: Goemon approves of a journey with interesting company.
text.zh-CN: 五右卫门赞成。一路上，总得有些有趣的人。

text.en: Alice, do try to come back with the same number of limbs.
text.zh-CN: 爱丽丝，回来时胳膊腿可别少了。

text.en: I'll do my best, Wendy. Come on—there must be a sensible path somewhere.
text.zh-CN: 我尽力，温蒂。走吧，总会有一条讲道理的路。

text.en: They call me the Huntsman. I've spent rather too long on the same stretch of road.
text.zh-CN: 大家叫我猎人。我在同一条路上，待得有点久了。

text.en: Come see a different one.
text.zh-CN: 来看看别的路吧。

text.en: I would. I'd also like to find Snow White. She has a habit of making friends in unlikely places.
text.zh-CN: 我愿意。也想去找找白雪公主。她总能在意想不到的地方交到朋友。

text.en: Then you'll fit right in.
text.zh-CN: 那你来对地方了。

text.en: The Scarecrow, at your service. I can't promise a brilliant plan every time, but I do know the value of keeping supplies handy.
text.zh-CN: 稻草人，为你效劳。我不敢保证每次都有妙计，不过，随身带好补给的道理，我还是懂的。

text.en: Let's see what we can make of this road.
text.zh-CN: 来看看这条路，能让我们遇上什么。

text.en: So much noise about where I belong. I'm tired of letting other people answer that question.
text.zh-CN: 人人都在议论我属于哪里。我不想再让别人替我回答了。

text.en: Then choose your own road, Thor. I'll stand beside you.
text.zh-CN: 那就自己选条路，索尔。我会站在你身边。

text.en: Preferably a road with an inn. Even noble decisions deserve dinner.
text.zh-CN: 最好是条有旅馆的路。再英明的决定，也得先吃晚饭。

text.en: For once, Loki, I agree. We'll travel together and find our own answers.
text.zh-CN: 这回我同意你，洛基。一起走吧，答案由我们自己找。

text.en: Good. One step at a time.
text.zh-CN: 好。先往前走一步。

text.en: You two made quite a team.
text.zh-CN: 你们两位配合得真不错。

text.en: Arthur and I have had a little practice. Thank you for helping us find one another again.
text.zh-CN: 我和亚瑟练过一些时候。谢谢你，帮我们重新找到了彼此。

text.en: Shall we leave the valley?
text.zh-CN: 一起出谷吧？

text.en: Yes. The Lady of the Lake would welcome a change of scenery.
text.zh-CN: 好。湖中仙女也想换个地方走走。

text.en: I learned a great deal in these mountains. Mostly that sitting still isn't for me.
text.zh-CN: 我在这些山里学会了不少东西。最清楚的一件，就是我坐不住。

text.en: Then come along, Nezha. There's plenty more to see.
text.zh-CN: 那就来吧，哪吒。还有好多地方没去过呢。

text.en: Leaving so soon? I've been looking for you.
text.zh-CN: 这么快就想走？我可找你很久了。

text.en: Shen Gongbao. Of course you'd arrive just as things got pleasant.
text.zh-CN: 申公豹。果然，刚有点好心情，你就来了。

text.en: Mulan! Are you hurt?
text.zh-CN: 木兰！你受伤了吗？

text.en: I'm all right. And I see you've found someone who can keep up with you.
text.zh-CN: 我没事。看来，你找到了能跟上你的旅伴。

text.en: Only just.
text.zh-CN: 勉强跟得上。

text.en: You stood with me when it mattered. I'd be glad to travel with you.
text.zh-CN: 要紧的时候，你帮了我。我愿意和你一起走。

text.en: Go on. I'll take care of things here.
text.zh-CN: 去吧。这里的事，我来处理。

text.en: I'd like to look in at Jade Summit when we have the chance.
text.zh-CN: 有机会的话，我还想回玉冠顶看看。

text.en: We'll keep it in mind. Let's go.
text.zh-CN: 记下了。走吧。

text.en: We've compared notes. Let's go after that wagon together.
text.zh-CN: 线索已经对上了，一起去追那辆马车吧。

text.en: Good. I'll watch the road. You watch for anyone selling us another giant.
text.zh-CN: 好。我看路，你提防那些还想给我们介绍巨人的人。

text.en: Well? Somebody say something. I can't supply every dramatic pause.
text.zh-CN: 怎么都不说话？总不能每次都让我负责等下文。

text.en: You can talk?
text.zh-CN: 你会说话？

text.en: The Griffin considers that its finest accomplishment.
text.zh-CN: 狮鹫一直觉得，这是它最了不起的本领。

text.en: It is. Come visit again, Arthur. Preferably without starting another fight.
text.zh-CN: 本来就是。记得回来看看，亚瑟。最好，别一回来就打架。

text.en: I will. Shall we see where your road leads?
text.zh-CN: 会的。一起去看看，你这条路通往哪里吧？

text.en: You've kept your word. Dracula will travel with you. I expect the same courtesy on the road.
text.zh-CN: 你守了诺言。德古拉愿意与你同行。路上，也请继续如此。

text.en: Heracles! Care to join us?
text.zh-CN: 赫拉克勒斯！一起走吗？

text.en: Gladly. Is there work to be done?
text.zh-CN: 乐意。有事需要我帮忙？

text.en: With this company? Almost certainly.
text.zh-CN: 和这群人一起？多半少不了。

text.en: Excellent. Lead on.
text.zh-CN: 那就好。带路吧。

text.en: There you are! You still owe me an answer.
text.zh-CN: 可算找到你了！你还欠我一个交代。

text.en: Your rule over this island is over, Nome King. I won't stay here to pretend otherwise.
text.zh-CN: 诺姆王，你对这座岛的统治结束了。我不会留下来，陪你假装一切照旧。

text.en: Go, then! I have no need of any of you!
text.zh-CN: 那就走！我谁也不需要！

text.en: We have room for another traveler, Glinda.
text.zh-CN: 我们这儿，还容得下一位旅伴，格琳达。

text.en: Then let's put that generous offer to good use. Come along.
text.zh-CN: 那就别浪费这份好意了。走吧。

text.en: We're clear. Thank you for coming to our aid.
text.zh-CN: 脱身了。谢谢各位出手相助。

text.en: Shu, you're hurt!
text.zh-CN: 舒，你受伤了！

text.en: Where are you headed? We can share the road.
text.zh-CN: 你们要去哪儿？可以一起走。

text.en: That would be welcome. Horus, stay close.
text.zh-CN: 那就有劳了。荷鲁斯，跟紧些。

text.en: So that is how the blade reached you. You have a knack for unusual journeys.
text.zh-CN: 原来，这把剑是这样到了你手里。你经历的旅途，还真不寻常。

text.en: The road keeps surprising me.
text.zh-CN: 这条路，总有些出人意料的地方。

text.en: Dorothy, shall we join them?
text.zh-CN: 多萝西，我们一起走吧？

text.en: All right. But I'm keeping an eye on the Scarecrow.
text.zh-CN: 好。不过，我可得留意着那位稻草人。

text.en: A splendid idea!
text.zh-CN: 这主意真好！

text.en: And you could use a little practice keeping out of trouble.
text.zh-CN: 你也该学着，少惹一点麻烦。

text.en: I'm a very willing student.
text.zh-CN: 我学起来，一定很认真。

text.en: Stay with us, Lion. Please.
text.zh-CN: 狮子，别丢下我们。求你了。

text.en: You've more courage than you think, my friend. Use it well.
text.zh-CN: 朋友，你比自己想的更勇敢。别辜负它。

text.en: Lion...
text.zh-CN: 狮子……

text.en: He mattered to you. I can see that.
text.zh-CN: 他对你很重要。我看得出来。

text.en: He stood by me. I won't forget it.
text.zh-CN: 他帮过我。我不会忘的。

text.en: Then I'll travel with you. We can look after one another.
text.zh-CN: 那我和你们一起走。路上，互相照应。

text.en: Thank you, Dorothy.
text.zh-CN: 谢谢你，多萝西。

text.en: Well done. You can look after one another.
text.zh-CN: 不错。看来，你们能互相照应。

text.en: You've come a long way, Huntsman.
text.zh-CN: 猎人，你这一路，可长进不少。

text.en: Snow White, the world has a few more lessons for you.
text.zh-CN: 白雪，外面还有不少东西，值得你去学。

text.en: Then let's go and find them.
text.zh-CN: 那就一起去看看吧。

程灵素答应医治金面佛苗人凤的眼睛.en: Gerda has agreed to help treat our poisoned friend.
程灵素答应医治金面佛苗人凤的眼睛.zh-CN: 格尔达答应帮助医治中毒的朋友。

风陵渡口偶遇郭芙、郭襄姐妹。.en: Met Wendy and Alice at the ferry.
风陵渡口偶遇郭芙、郭襄姐妹。.zh-CN: 在渡口遇见温蒂和爱丽丝。

绝情谷底，杨过与小龙女久别重逢。.en: Arthur and the Lady of the Lake have reunited in the valley.
绝情谷底，杨过与小龙女久别重逢。.zh-CN: 亚瑟与湖中仙女在谷底重逢。

剑魔荒冢战胜神雕、杨过。.en: Completed the bout with Arthur and the Griffin.
剑魔荒冢战胜神雕、杨过。.zh-CN: 完成了与亚瑟、狮鹫的切磋。

description.en: Increases Energy costs. Sunflower Mastery and Nightblade Sword always score critical hits.
description.zh-CN: 增加能量消耗。使用向日葵专精和夜刃剑术时必定暴击。
